questions.prompt: Who did the tricky high building work?
questions.evidenceText: Dad did the tricky high bits — the tall planks and the big nails. James and Anna passed the tools and held the wood still.

questions.prompt: What did they build after the floor?
questions.evidenceText: Then they made the walls and cut a little door. James helped saw a window hole with a small hand saw.

questions.prompt: How did Anna feel about the finished tree house?
questions.rationale: Anna calling the tree house the best thing they had made shows that she felt proud of their work.
questions.evidenceText: James and Anna climbed up and sat at the little window. "This is the best thing we have ever made," said Anna.
